subject: Crescent Labs — DPA redlines and SCCs: role mapping needed
messages:
From: Marta Villanueva <marta.v@crescentlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crescentlabs.com, Diane Luo <diane.luo@outsidecounsel.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crescent Labs — DPA redlines and SCCs: role mapping needed

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. We've reviewed the MSA and order form and have a handful of DPA redlines tied to SCC selection and controller/processor roles for our EU flows. High-level items:

- We need to confirm whether Redwood will be listed as "processor" or "sub-processor" for the model inference logs stored in the EU region.
- Proposed language for SCCs — our counsel would like the new EU SCCs (2021) referenced and a mechanism for ordering subprocessors and providing 30-day notice.
- A small technical ask: can you map which Redwood services (hosting, logging, analytics) will access customer PII so we can match to the role matrix?

I've attached our initial markup (PDF attached to this message) and Diane from our outside counsel is copied for legal detail. We'd like to get an agreed role map and updated DPA redline before our procurement kickoff next Wednesday.

Can we get an internal point-of-contact and an ETA for a consolidated response?

Thanks,
Marta Villanueva
Head of Compliance, Crescent Labs
marta.v@crescentlabs.com
+44 20 7946 0550

Attachment: crescent_dpa_playbook_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Villanueva <marta.v@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crescent Labs — DPA redlines and SCCs: role mapping needed

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear summary and the attach. Quick notes while I pull internal teams together: 

- Short answer on roles: Redwood will be the Processor for hosted inference and embeddings storage; we act as Controller only where customers opt into data enrichment services (not relevant for your flows as discussed). I'll confirm the logging/analytics split below.
- We'll accept the 2021 SCCs; need to surface any orderform language required for execution and subprocessor notice windows.
- Ops/infra owners (Ben, Olga) — can you produce a one-page role matrix showing: service, data types, storage region, and whether we act as processor/sub-processor? Goal: give Crescent the row-level mapping so they can reconcile with their TIA.

Marta — target timeline from our side: internal role matrix and a first-pass redline of the DPA by 16 March EOD (UK time). If that works, we'll then propose a DocuSign for the DPA addendum and the SCCs.

I'll follow up with the attachments (redline + XLS) once Ben/Olga have them.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Crescent Labs — DPA redlines and SCCs: role mapping needed

Jordan / Olga — attaching the role matrix and my operational notes. I flagged the specific services that touch EU customer data:

- Inference-host (inference-host-eu): token stream (ephemeral), model cache (no persistent PII) — Processor.
- Customer logs (logstore-eu): request metadata + minimal prompt hashes — Processor; retention configurable per customer.
- Analytics pipeline (analytics-prod): aggregated telemetry for model performance — sub-processor for a subset of telemetry; no raw prompts stored.

Notes on subprocessors: we already use CloudGrid EU for block-storage; that will need to be listed in Exhibit B. We provide 30-day advance notice for new subprocessors (standard).

Attachments: sccs_role_matrix_20270316.xlsx, crescent_dpa_redlines_20270316.docx

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales (EMEA), Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Villanueva <marta.v@crescentlabs.com>, procurement@crescentlabs.com
Cc: Diane Luo <diane.luo@outsidecounsel.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Crescent Labs — DPA redlines and SCCs: consolidated response and next steps

Hi Marta / Procurement team —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is a consolidated package from Redwood:

1) crescent_dpa_redlines_20270316.docx — our proposed DPA edits with inline comments. Key points summarized on page 1.
2) sccs_role_matrix_20270316.xlsx — row-level mapping of Redwood services, data categories, storage region, and role designation (processor/sub-processor).

Summary of the core asks we accepted / proposed changes:
- SCCs: we will incorporate the 2021 SCCs. We propose executing them as an addendum (Exhibit B) at signature to avoid re-executing via separate signature flow.
- Subprocessor notice: Redwood confirms 30-day notice and will publish a live subprocessor register (link in doc).
- Retention & logging: default retention for logstore-eu is 30 days; we will include a configurable retention field in the order form (Order Form, Section 4.2).
- Controller/Processor roles: the attached XLS shows processor for inference-host and logstore; analytics pipeline is scoped as sub-processor for aggregated telemetry only.

Next steps: if the package looks good, please confirm by EOD Friday (19 Mar) so that we can prepare the DocuSign envelope with: (a) DPA addendum incorporating SCCs and (b) updated order form line item for retention. If Crescent prefers, we can route the DocuSign only after legal sign-off from Diane.

DocuSign (preview): https://app.docusign.com/Signing/Start?doc=CRS-1549
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/CRS-1549
HubSpot: 2345678

Attachments: crescent_dpa_redlines_20270316.docx (docx), sccs_role_matrix_20270316.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute call if you'd like to walk through the changes.

Best,
